instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: In the classroom, there are 45 pencils which make up 30% of the pencils in the school in total. How many pencils are there in the school?
In a library, there are 350 red books which make up 10% of the total number of books in the library. How many books are there in the library?
The local market sells two kinds of fruit. 30 watermelons make up 40% of the fruit and bananas make up the rest. How many pieces of fruit are there in total?
Kate is spending some money on a new game that she wants. It costs £243 which makes up 18% of her savings. Work out how much money she had in her savings before she bought the game.
Girls make up 56% of Patrick’s school year. There are 154 girls in his year. Work out how many people there are in his year in total.
